It was a partly cloudy morning in Canberra with temperatures reaching 20°C. You asked me to check your calendar, which included the standup at 9:30 AM, the architecture sync at 11:00 AM, and the demo rehearsal at 3:30 PM. I set a reminder for the rehearsal to start ten minutes early. You also mentioned you slept really badly again, so I set a wind-down cue for tonight at 9:00 PM.

For your Thursday Demo note, I added details about showing the new export button and the error state during the rehearsal. When searching for a vegetarian recipe with sweet potato and black beans, the search didn't return good results, but you asked me to suggest something from scratch instead. I suggested sweet potato and black bean burrito bowls, which you accepted, and I provided the steps to get that ready tonight.

You shared that your neck and shoulders are holding tension, noting it likely comes from not sleeping well and hunching over the laptop. On a brighter note, you had a small win this afternoon when you got the export button working and merged it. I hope the wind-down reminder helps you rest better tonight.
